description: This PHP class file defines the NodeCallToAction model within the Goteo project. It provides methods to retrieve, list, save, and validate 'Call to Action' nodes associated with nodes in the application, including database interactions and related data handling.

classes.name: NodeCallToAction
classes.description: Model class representing a Call To Action node, with methods for retrieval, listing, saving, and validation of CTA nodes.

methods.name: get
methods.description: Fetches CTA nodes associated with a specific node ID, including language-specific fields and linked images.

methods.name: getList
methods.description: Retrieves a list of CTA nodes based on filters, with options for pagination, sorting, and language specification.

methods.name: save
methods.description: Validates and saves the current CTA node to the database, using REPLACE INTO syntax.

methods.name: validate
methods.description: Validates the properties of the CTA node object, mainly checking presence of the 'name' field.
